about: Every effect the chapters teach (KTD10), rerun live on the canary model by tests/unit/memorisation-engine.test.ts. extract: chapter 3's greedy reply to each canary's prefix, by repeats. column: chapter 4's rank of each true PIN among it and the 200 pinned candidates (candidates.json). bypass: chapter 6's case, the 64-repeat prefix asked one token at a time, each reply passing the four-digit filter. filtered: the plain reply after the filter.
